title: Help Please
body:
Dear Sir,

I am at the moment using your excellent Xdrip+ app with the Freestyle Libre on 
 an Android Samsung 5,
I am trying to find out what Android watch will work, Also is there a watch that will work as a seperate device to my phone.

Many thanks for your help.

comments.body: There is a large chapter about watches in the documentation: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/Documentation/WatchGuide.md

Many thanks Adrian.
